title: An Astronomic View
description: Photographer Andrew McCarthy took this image of skydiver Gabriel Brown silhouetted against the sun after Brown leaped from a motorized paraglider over Arizona’s Sonoran Desert. To create the surreal backdrop, McCarthy connected his camera to a modified telescope that can reveal the chromosphere—a layer of gases and plasma that surrounds the sun. He then stacked multiple exposures to enhance the effect. This photo is featured in the "In Focus" series in the July 2026 issue of National Geographic.
translated_description: 摄影师安德鲁·麦卡锡捕捉到跳伞者加布里埃尔·布朗以太阳为背景的剪影画面——布朗从亚利桑那州索诺兰沙漠上空的动力滑翔伞上跃下。为营造超现实背景，麦卡锡将相机连接至改装望远镜，该设备能呈现太阳周围的色球层（由气体与等离子体构成的太阳大气层）。随后他通过叠加多重曝光强化视觉效果。这张照片刊登于《国家地理》2026年7月刊"焦点"系列专题。
